requires_external_validation.scope: Review the stipulated transport/circuit laws and run a frozen <=1 cm^2 isotope-labelled oxide/quartz admission test with all contacts inside a measured V/I/temperature/power boundary. Require feed-derived Fe export beyond 100 times all accessible preloaded inventory, sustained replenishment and repeated harvests, full Fe/carbon/scaffold balance and impurity assay against matched bias-off, reversed, blocked, no-ore and pure-Fe controls. Only then assess untreated real ore, recovery, lifetime and full-process economics.
